info.title: EstateFlow API
info.description:
REST API behind the EstateFlow Android app (PHP + PostgreSQL, hosted on Wasmer).

**How the API is shaped.** Each resource is one PHP file under `/api/`. The HTTP method picks
what happens, and some files also take an `action` (in the query string or the JSON body)
to choose between several operations on the same method.

**Signing in.** `POST /auth.php` returns a `token`. Send it on later calls as
`Authorization: Bearer <token>` (use the **Authorize** button). With a token, the server
filters data to the signed-in user: buyers see only their own bookings and chats, agents
only those on their own listings. Without a token, requests still work while the server
setting `AUTH_REQUIRED` is off, and then return everyone's data. A token that is present
but invalid or expired is always rejected with 401. No token is issued while the server
setting `AUTH_SECRET` is missing (`token` is then `null`).

**Errors** always look like `{"success": false, "error": "message"}`.

post.summary: Sign in, sign up, change password or update agent profile
post.description:
Pick the operation with `action` (query string, or an `action` field in the body).
Each one takes a different body; choose a matching example below.

| action | Who | Body | Success |
|---|---|---|---|
| `client_login` (default) | buyer | email, password | 200 AuthResponse |
| `client_signup` | buyer | name, email, password (8+), phone | 201 AuthResponse |
| `agent_login` | agent | emailOrLicense, password | 200 AuthResponse |
| `agent_signup` | agent | name, email, licenseNo, password (8+), agency, professionalRole | 201 AuthResponse |
| `update_password` | anyone | email, currentPassword, newPassword (8+) | 200 PasswordUpdated |
| `update_profile` | signed-in agent only | name, email, licenseNo, title | 200 AgentProfile |

Sign-in, sign-up and password changes are limited to 5 wrong attempts per account in
15 minutes (then 429). Agent license numbers must be `PRC-REB-` plus 7 digits.

200.description: Signed in, password changed, or profile updated

get.summary: List listings, or get one by id
get.description: Public, no sign-in needed. With `id` it returns one Property; otherwise a list, newest first.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Return just this listing (for example prop_pinecrest). Leave empty to list all.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Text in title, address, city or description

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Property type (for example Condominium), or All

200.description: One listing (with id) or a list

post.description:
Creates a listing, or overwrites it if `id` already exists. A signed-in agent's listing
is always saved under their own name and email, and they can't overwrite another
agent's listing (403). Also adds a "New Property Published" notification.

With `action=delete` this deletes instead (same as `DELETE`, pass `id`).

put.summary: Toggle favourite, or update a listing (agents)
put.description:
With `action=toggle_favorite` and `id`, flips the listing's favourite flag (one flag
per listing, shared by everyone). Without an action, this is a full update and works
like `POST` (agents only).

delete.description:
Deletes the listing, cancels its open viewings, and adds a "Listing Removed"
notification. A signed-in agent can only delete their own listings.

get.description: Buyers get their own; agents get those on their own listings; no token gets all.

post.description:
Books a viewing (or updates status, date, time and notes if `id` exists). A signed-in
buyer always books as themselves. Adds a "Viewing Appointment Booked" notification.

get.summary: List conversations, or get one by id
get.description:
Each inquiry is one conversation about one property with one buyer, including its
messages. Buyers get their own; agents get those on their own listings; no token gets all.

200.description: One conversation (with id) or a list, most recently active first

post.summary: Start a conversation, or reply in one
post.description:
**New message from a buyer:** send `propertyId` and `message`. If this buyer already has
a conversation about the property, the message is added to it. Adds a "New Lead
Inquiry" notification. Returns the whole conversation.

**Reply:** use `action=reply` with `inquiryId` and `replyText`. When signed in, the server
decides whether the reply is from the agent or the buyer; without a token `isAgent`
decides (default true).

value.replyText: Hi Marcus! There are no HOA fees on this parcel.

201.description: Conversation (new message) or the saved reply

get.description:
Notifications have no recipient yet. Buyers get listing updates plus notifications about
their own bookings and conversations; agents and no-token callers get every notification.

put.summary: Mark one, or all, as read

message.example: Skyline Penthouse at The Zenith is now ₱2,000,000.

targetId.description: Related listing, booking or conversation id

get.summary: Download everything the caller may see
get.description:
What the app downloads on Sync: all listings, plus appointments, conversations and
notifications filtered by who is signed in, plus an agent profile. With no token and
`AUTH_REQUIRED` off, everything is returned.

post.summary: Upload listings and appointments, then download everything (agents)
post.description:
Saves the `properties` and `appointments` sent (by id; existing ones are overwritten),
then returns the same response as `GET`. A signed-in agent's listings are saved under
their own name, and another agent's listings in the upload are skipped.

bearerAuth.description: The `token` returned by a sign-in or sign-up in `POST /auth.php`. Valid for 30 days, or until the password changes.

Unauthorized.description: Wrong email or password, or the token is missing (when AUTH_REQUIRED is on), invalid or expired

Forbidden.description: Signed in, but not allowed (wrong role, or someone else's record)

TooManyAttempts.description: Too many wrong attempts; wait 15 minutes

token.description: Send as `Authorization Bearer`. Null while AUTH_SECRET is not set on the server.
New token; the old one stops working
